brief: Complete medium-fi70Pine: asymmetric58-part Art Deco tower, five entrances, recessed brick sash bays, fan terrace railings, tiered lantern and stainless spire.

appearance.identity: Light gray brick/limestone asymmetric Art Deco slab with multiple setbacks, eastern shaft, five monumental portals and tiered lantern/spire.
appearance.scope: Whole medium-fi exterior retains58 mapped masonry, lantern and spire parts; asymmetric base, slender eastern slab, repeated setbacks, five street portals, two tower portraits and27ft lantern below97ft spire. Original539422-triangle detailed recipe remains reproducible in Git. Reviewed source adds three revolving-door forms at western Pine/Cedar and Pearl entrances; door dimensions and exact present hardware are original reconstruction, not surveyed. LPC2011 photos/text inform historic fabric; current owner corroborates restored Art Deco building and residential conversion. Original master retains generic reconstructed facade pitch, reliefs and fan railings, without copied meshes or photo textures. District uses canonical window_punched as generic bay motif. Street/closeup merge repeated piers, reveal strips and spandrels; closeup keeps abstract brick motifs and simplified fan rails. Minute lettering, inscriptions and fine grillwork are below browser error. Full parcel footprint is preserved without scaling. Street slope, actual grade, night performance and physical-device timings are unmeasured. Separate Pine footbridge, adjoining buildings, interiors and tenant branding are outside this asset. The reviewed western Pine portal now follows accessible mapped doorwayx-13.874, correcting its previous9.1m offset.
